[DefaultCanvasHistoryService]
CanvasEditingContext {contextId} --> WeakMap --> CanvasHistory
runtime object handles isolate viewers; handles are not saved
state --> checkpointId + document + view + canUndo / canRedo

[Coordinated document and view]
append(resolved document, canvas view, node correspondence)
--> one canvas checkpoint
navigate / reset --> restore document + view in controller
linked transaction --> navigate throws: use workspace undo/redo

[Incremental persistence]
CanvasSession.onCommit --> CanvasWorkspace.onPersist(document IDs)
--> WorkspacePersistence
per-session cursor --> historyChanges --> revision / checkpoint keys
metadata + saved baseline + canvas + viewport + workspace index
replacement session --> remove obsolete graph records in same batch
immutable revision IDs already stored --> skip duplicate writes

[SourcePaneViewState capture]
captureDisplay --> saved scroll; captureCamera --> saved viewport
view subscription --> syncView --> canvas / viewport records

[RecordStorage]
synchronous cache + pending changes coalesced by key
--> one in-flight batch {requestId, expectedRevision, changes}
--> WorkspaceStorage: one persistent worker --> records API
ordinary batch: debounce 150 ms; pending wait bounded at 1000 ms
commit: flush prior writes --> submit --> await acknowledgement
interrupted response --> retry identical request / ID
definitive REJECTED --> restore prior cache; abandon operation

[MappingPage transfer: copy / move]
beginTransfer --> selected IDs + captured source canvasRevisionId
verify source revision; pause persistence; capture workspace
runWorkspaceTask(transfer): source history + destination history?
--> prepared source + destination + transaction
move --> prepared source document/history/view
copy --> source deselected; destination receives prepared state

[Publish transfer]
storage.save(workspace)
--> flush --> project records --> RecordStorage.commit
--> acknowledgement --> installWorkspace
sessions + transfer record + active document installed together
new SourcePaneViewState; destination becomes active

[Workspace undo / redo]
transferBoundary --> locate linked transaction
both canvases required; undo newer related transfers first
prepareTransferNavigation --> both states + updated transaction
--> save --> acknowledgement --> installWorkspace
undo created destination --> hidden; redo --> visible
ordinary undo / redo --> controller --> history.navigate

Sources: canvasHistoryService.ts; MappingPage.tsx; canvasSession.ts;
workspacePersistence.ts; recordStorage.ts; workspaceStorage.ts
